disease_label_per_paper: Acute non-hemolytic febrile transfusion reaction after platelet concentrate
presentation_summary: A 67-year-old man with non-Hodgkin lymphoma developed an acute non-hemolytic transfusion reaction after platelet concentrate transfusion.
The reported reaction was febrile with fever and chills.
The platelet concentrate was from a female donor and had prestorage leukoreduction.
Donor serum had HLA class I antibody reactive with the patient's A24 antigen and AHG-LCT crossmatch was positive; this antibody workup is confirmatory/non-ranking.
The article separates this febrile ANHTR case from TRALI/dyspnea and allergic reaction cases.
